description: This file contains FastAPI route handlers and helper functions for managing models in a proxy server context. It includes endpoints for creating, updating, deleting models, managing model groups, and related utilities with complex logic for team-based model management, authentication, and cache management.

classes.name: ModelManagementAuthChecks
classes.description: Contains static methods for authorization checks related to model management, including user permission validation, team membership, and protection against unauthorized updates.

methods.name: Optional[Deployment] get_db_model( model_id: str, prisma_client: PrismaClient )
methods.description: Fetches a model deployment from the database using its model_id.

methods.name: PrismaCompatibleUpdateDBModel update_db_model( db_model: Deployment, updated_patch: updateDeployment )
methods.description: Merges updates from a patch into an existing Deployment object, encrypts sensitive fields, and prepares data for database update.

methods.name: patch_model( model_id: str, patch_data: updateDeployment, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: PATCH endpoint handler to update existing model info in the database, with auth checks and cache clearing.

methods.name: Optional[LiteLLM_ProxyModelTable] _add_model_to_db( model_params: Deployment, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, prisma_client: PrismaClient, new_encryption_key: Optional[str] = None, should_create_model_in_db: bool = True, )
methods.description: Adds a new model record in the database, encrypting sensitive parameters.

methods.name: Optional[LiteLLM_ProxyModelTable] _add_team_model_to_db( model_params: Deployment, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, prisma_client: PrismaClient, )
methods.description: Creates a unique team model with alias and associates it with a team.

methods.name: PrismaCompatibleUpdateDBModel _update_team_model_in_db( db_model: Deployment, patch_data: updateDeployment, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, prisma_client: PrismaClient, )
methods.description: Handles team model update logic, creating aliases and updating team associations if necessary.

methods.name: str _get_public_model_name( patch_data: updateDeployment, db_model: Deployment, )
methods.description: Determines the effective public model name based on patch data or existing model info.

methods.name: None _setup_new_team_model_assignment( team_id: str, public_model_name: str, patch_data: updateDeployment, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, )
methods.description: Sets up a new team model with unique name and alias, updating team info and models.

methods.name: None _update_existing_team_model_assignment( team_id: str, public_model_name: str, db_model: Deployment, patch_data: updateDeployment, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, )
methods.description: Updates alias for an existing team model if the public name changed.

methods.name: List[Tuple[str,str]] delete_team_model_alias( public_model_name: str, prisma_client: PrismaClient, )
methods.description: Removes a team model alias by its public name and updates database accordingly.

methods.name: update_public_model_groups( request: UpdatePublicModelGroupsRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Endpoint to update which model groups are marked as public. Requires admin role.

methods.name: update_useful_links( request: UpdateUsefulLinksRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Endpoint to update useful external links configuration. Requires admin role.

methods.name: clear_cache()
methods.description: Clears database models from the router cache and reloads models, preserving config models.
